Supported Case Policy

Current supported Bonneville/ReducedGUI baseline
- temp_case_work
- 绀轰緥鏂囦欢2

Package mapping
- packaging\cases\minimal_case_inputs
  Clean-input case derived from 绀轰緥鏂囦欢2 and cleaned to match the final no-TDG reduced contract.
- packaging\cases\minimal_case_verified
  Verified-output snapshot derived from temp_case_work after the Stage 4 TDG cleanup.

Supported reduced capabilities
- gate / spill / pipe structure-flow behavior
- structural withdrawal behavior
- selective-withdrawal temperature control

Unsupported reduced capabilities
- TDG files: `w2_systdg.npt`, `w2_TDGtarget.csv`, `TDGdyntarget.csv`
- TDG outputs: `TDG_output.csv`, `TDGTarget_output.csv`, `TDGTarget_warning.opt`
- `%DO` / `TDG` output requests
- `GASSPC = ON` / `GASGTC = ON`

Current unsupported legacy case
- 绀轰緥鏂囦欢

Why 绀轰緥鏂囦欢 is unsupported in this package baseline
- It is a different and larger legacy case shape than the current Bonneville baseline.
- The current reduced CSV compatibility path is targeted at the Bonneville structure-flow baseline.
- Historical testing indicates 绀轰緥鏂囦欢 did not run reliably even with the original v455 executable.

Support boundary
- This package guarantees only the Bonneville/ReducedGUI baseline described above.
- TDG-enabled Bonneville variants are outside the supported reduced deliverable boundary.
- Supporting 绀轰緥鏂囦欢 should be treated as a separate compatibility project.
